posts.title: Version 0.3 Beta: Enums, Match, State Machines
posts.description: Today we're announcing Mech v0.3-beta, which introduces new features for data modeling, computation, control flow, and document presentation. Also, Mika the Mech is making her debut as Mech's mascot.

posts.title: Fall 2025 Progress Report - Mechdown Beta
posts.description: Progress on Mech v0.2, nearing release. This cycle focused on the data specification language, the standard library, and tooling. v0.2 began on July 16 2024 and now includes more than 2900 commits. This report covers progress up to v0.2.66-beta.

posts.title: LLMs Won't Replace Programming Languages
posts.description: Welcome to 2025! It's been a while since the last blog post so this will be a packed update. Development has hit highs and lows over the past couple years so in this post I will cover all of it, including a discussion on the future of Mech and programming languages generally in a world of generative AI.
